title: Vet Visit Weekly Days Since Last Visit Trend
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vet:visit days_since_last_visit=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_since_last_visit) as avg_duration, max(days_since_last_visit) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days since last visit for vet visit events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_since_last_visit on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days since last visit with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether vet visit tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
